new_learnings.text: A split tape with a very strong 科创50 and semiconductor surge can still be a no-entry day when the broad buy gate fails.
new_learnings.mechanism: Index-level leadership concentrated in one risk cluster does not offset weak breadth, only 1/3 major indices green, and elevated limit-down count; momentum entries need both leadership and healthy participation.

new_learnings.text: The MA-distance anti-chase rule is excluding many of the strongest-looking names in semis, PCB and communication hardware today, which is exactly its job.
new_learnings.mechanism: Names like 华峰测控、东材科技、广合科技、上海新阳、鼎通科技 all have valid narratives but are stretched too far above short-term support, making reward/risk poor for fresh entries.

new_learnings.text: Best blocked candidates today are the ones with acceptable MA distance first, not the ones with the strongest headline momentum.
new_learnings.mechanism: In a weak regime, preserving a shortlist of technically non-extended names like 明阳电路、北化股份、云图控股 is more useful than reacting to already vertical leaders.
